Congress alleges BJP seeks two-thirds majority to end reservation

The Congress party has accused the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) of aiming for a two-thirds majority in the Lok Sabha. According to Congress leaders, this majority is intended to amend the Constitution and abolish reservation policies. The allegations link the BJP's pursuit of a majority to its electoral strategies and potential constitutional changes.
